description: Defines the implementation class srs_scheduler_impl for scheduling SRS resources in a cellular network, including methods for adding/removing UEs, scheduling slots, and handling positioning requests.

classes.name: srs_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the srs_scheduler interface for managing SRS scheduling in a cellular network.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SRS for the current slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, called on cell deactivation.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE configuration to the scheduler.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE configuration from the scheduler.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE with new settings.
